title: Registration accepts an email address differing only by letter case
author: Maciej Rajtar
actual result: Registration completed successfully using [ADMIN@juice-sh.op](mailto:ADMIN@juice-sh.op), although the test expected the application to reject an email address differing from the existing address only by letter case. The application displayed a registration success message and redirected to the Login page. The newly created account was accessible, and its profile displayed [ADMIN@juice-sh.op](mailto:ADMIN@juice-sh.op).

title: Registration succeeds after changing the password without updating the confirmation field
author: Maciej Rajtar
actual result: After the Password field was changed without updating the Repeat Password field, no validation message indicating that the passwords did not match was displayed. The Register button remained enabled, and the application allowed registration to be completed despite the mismatched passwords.

title: Repeat Password field accepts 41 characters without a validation error (counter shows 41/40)
author: Maciej Rajtar
actual result: STEPS: 1. Open the User Registration form (Account > Login > "Not yet a customer?"). 2. Paste the same 41-character value into the Password and Repeat Password fields. 3. Compare the validation messages of both fields. || EXPECTED: Repeat Password enforces the same 5-40 character limit as Password (validation error or input limit). || ACTUAL: Repeat Password accepts all 41 characters (counter 41/40) and shows no validation error, while Password shows "Password must be 5-40 characters long." for the same value. The Register button stays disabled only because of the Password error; no account is created. || ENVIRONMENT: OWASP Juice Shop v20.2.0 (local), Firefox. || RELATED: found during execution of OJST-15.

title: Password character counter shows 40/20 although the field accepts up to 40 characters
author: Maciej Rajtar
actual result: STEPS: 1. Open the User Registration form (Account > Login > "Not yet a customer?"). 2. Enter 40 characters in the Password field. 3. Observe the character counter on the right of the password hint. || EXPECTED: The counter shows 40/40, consistent with the hint "Password must be 5-40 characters long" and with the Repeat Password counter (0/40 on an empty field). || ACTUAL: The Password counter shows 40/20 (0/20 on an empty field), although 40 characters are accepted without an error. A 41-character value is rejected with "Password must be 5-40 characters long", so the validation limit is 40 and only the counter limit (20) is wrong. || ENVIRONMENT: OWASP Juice Shop v20.2.0 (local), Firefox. || RELATED: found during execution of OJST-15.

title: No specific validation message for invalid email format on login
author: Maciej Rajtar
actual result: The login form accepts the invalid email format "besoj57936.pl" and allows submission. After submission, the application displays "Invalid email or password." instead of a specific email format validation message.
